summary: Iteration 23 — Tested SF bug-fixes, Phase B Contacts fields, Phase C Masters (admin CRUD + 403, search, cascade, seed counts), and frontend flows for Contacts modal tab order, Admin Masters UI, SF list timestamps, and SF header. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass. Frontend: All testable UI checks pass. Q3 capability picker text verified via source (live click-test requires multi-step entry setup). Deprecated package detected: expo-av is still installed and imported.

minor.issue: POST /api/contacts persists ALL Phase-2 fields (occupation/drives/traits/profile_image/resources.finance.*) but does NOT persist `languages` array on initial create — it is only writable via PUT /api/contacts/{id}. Verified: round-trip GET shows the field missing after POST but present after a follow-up PUT. Recommend adding `languages` to the POST allowed field list in /app/backend/routes/contacts.py.

issues: No testID attributes on TouchableOpacity buttons (chips, +, edit, delete) — makes automated UI tests brittle. Recommend adding testIDs.
No testID attributes on tab buttons, currency chips, photo picker, or finance fields.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated package expo-av@^16.0.8 is still installed and imported. Reference: /app/frontend/package.json:26, /app/frontend/src/components/AudioGuidePlayer.tsx:5, /app/frontend/src/components/VoiceInput.tsx:11. Console shows: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the expo-audio and expo-video packages.' Migrate audio playback/recording to expo-audio and video to expo-video.

action_items: Add `languages` field to POST /api/contacts allowed-fields list (currently only PUT accepts it). Open /app/backend/routes/contacts.py around the create handler.

Migrate from deprecated expo-av to expo-audio + expo-video. Update /app/frontend/src/components/AudioGuidePlayer.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/VoiceInput.tsx and remove expo-av from package.json.

Add testID attributes to interactive elements in /app/frontend/app/admin/masters.tsx (chips, add button, edit/delete icons, modal save/cancel) and /app/frontend/app/tools/contacts.tsx (tab buttons, currency chips, photo picker, finance fields) to enable robust automated UI testing.

OPTIONAL: End-to-end UI test of Q3 capability picker (requires creating an SF entry with concern → cause to reach step 5). Text strings verified in source at /app/frontend/app/tools/solution-finder.tsx lines 622, 676, 983.
critical_code_review_comments: Inconsistency between POST and PUT field whitelists in /app/backend/routes/contacts.py (`languages` only in PUT). New Contact UI sends `languages` array on create; field is silently dropped.
Several files use deprecated expo-av — high-priority migration before SDK 54 upgrade.
No testID props on interactive elements in admin/masters.tsx, tools/contacts.tsx — adds friction to UI test automation (system prompt mandates testIDs).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all visible flows OK; Q3 capability picker only static-text verified

seed_data_creation: None retained — all test-created masters & contacts deleted in test teardown.
